mechanism_name: Post-silence quote-recentering drift (arrival-structure conditioned book on the UTC-H1 grid)
mechanism_story: WHO IS SLOW TO REACT / FORCED: the liquidity providers. On 24/7 perps, quote re-centering is activity-triggered, not clock-triggered: during inter-trade silence resting quotes go stale relative to information already priced on other venues, and no local trade forces the mid to move. The first aggressive burst after the silence must CROSS the stale spread — the taker is the forced side — and the liquidity provider then re-centers quotes toward the burst over subsequent buckets, moving the mid further in the resumption direction. WHY THE EFFECT EXISTS: this is quote-driven underreaction, a liquidity-supply response, not behavioral momentum — re-centering is incurred only when flow forces it, so the resumption bucket impounds the new fair value only partially at trade price and the remainder bleeds into the following 1-2 buckets as a directional drift. The information source is the trade-ARRIVAL CLOCK (time gaps between trades and the resumption of trade-count intensity), a dimension no forbidden family consumes: not price-vs-VWAP displacement, not same-side runs, not aggressor flow imbalance, not volume or size levels, not funding. WHAT OBSERVABLE MEASURES IT: the sparse trigger mask — silence entering the hour (entry_gap_s >= trailing-720-bucket P90) AND resumption (n_trades >= 1.5 x trailing-720-bucket median) — with direction sign(last_price - first_price) of the closed trigger bucket; the measure is the after-cost drift over the next 2 buckets. WHEN IT MUST FAIL: when colocated LPs re-center faster than one bucket (drift consumed before it pays); when silence is a news-embargo rather than idleness (resumption mean-reverts instead of continuing); deterministically when the trigger starves (<5% duty) and always when the per-round-trip drift is smaller than the per-round-trip taker cost at tier 2.0.
universe: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT on Binance USD-M perps, each traded independently (no cross-symbol leg); panel per symbol: 8,760 UTC-H1 rows, S0 2025-08-22..2026-08-21.
clock: H1 (decision at each hourly bucket close; entry at the next bucket's VWAP; holding measured in H1 buckets).
warmup: 720 H1 decisions per symbol (30-day trailing window) consumed for the rolling P90 of entry_gap_s and the rolling median of n_trades; both rolling statistics use ONLY buckets strictly before the trigger bucket (expanding-window statistics are used instead of percentiles for the first buckets after the 720-decision warmup if the harness so elects — the frozen spec is the trailing-720 window). No decision is taken before decision index 720 per symbol.
features_and_lags: Inputs (section-2 column names only), all read from the CLOSED trigger bucket b (rows with close_ts <= decision time t; NO same-bucket close peeking — bucket b is fully closed at the decision instant): entry_gap_s(b) (silence duration entering bucket b), n_trades(b) (resumption intensity), first_price(b), last_price(b) (direction sign only). Lag spec: trailing-720-bucket per-symbol histories of entry_gap_s and n_trades ending at b-1 (strictly prior buckets) define the P90 threshold Q90_s(b) = 90th percentile of {entry_gap_s(b') : b-720 <= b' < b} and the median M_s(b) = median({n_trades(b') : b-720 <= b' < b}). Derivation classes used (allowed): rolling ratios/percentiles over published columns. Trigger(b) = [entry_gap_s(b) >= Q90_s(b)] AND [n_trades(b) >= 1.5 x M_s(b)]. dir(b) = sign(last_price(b) - first_price(b)). Columns deliberately NOT used: buy/sell counts and quantities, quote/qty totals, vwap, high/low, max_trade_quote, sum_qty_squared, n_price_moves, sum_squared_log_ret, gap_sum_s, gap_count, run_* columns — to keep the arrival-clock source distinct from run/flow/size/absorption ancestries.
entry_exit_fills: Entry rule: if Trigger(b) fires at the close of bucket b and the book is flat, enter sign(dir(b)) x 1 unit notional on symbol s; fill at the next bucket's published vwap (bucket b+1) — next-bucket VWAP default, once per fill. Exit/holding rule: time exit after K=2 held buckets — cover at the published vwap of bucket b+K+1 (b+3). Re-trigger in the same direction while in position: ignored (no pyramiding). Opposite-direction trigger while in position: flip at the next bucket's vwap. No stop, no target. Force-flat: any open position is closed at the last published vwap before each fold-boundary purge zone (+/-1 full UTC day around internal fold boundaries); the trigger machinery resumes at the first decision after the purge.
costs: Taker fee charged EXACTLY ONCE PER FILL (acknowledged). Schedule: 5.0 bps baseline fee with tier multipliers x1.0/x1.5/x2.0 and slip floors 1/1/2 ticks; TIER 2.0 IS THE PRIMARY BOOK (10.0 bps + 2-tick slip floor per fill). Stress multipliers apply to BOOKED PnL. Two taker fills per event (entry + time exit; a flip counts as two fills).
anchor: For each symbol s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT} independently: the sparse arrival-conditioned book defined by Trigger(b) with frozen parameters (P90 silence threshold, 1.5x resumption multiple, K=2 holding buckets), direction dir(b), entries at bucket b+1 vwap, exits at bucket b+3 vwap, opposite-trigger flips at next-bucket vwap, force-flat at fold edges, once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs. This is the exact book definition; no parameter is fitted on outcomes.
neighbour: Same mechanism (post-silence quote-recentering drift), different frozen parameters: silence threshold P75 of trailing-720 entry_gap_s, resumption multiple 1.2 x trailing-720 median n_trades, holding K=4 buckets (exit at bucket b+5 vwap). Same symbols, same direction rule, same fills, same once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs, same force-flat law. Frozen; not re-optimized. G10 neighbour-support applies.
control: Reshuffled-interval placebo (the mechanism class is arrival-structure, so the convenient explanation to kill is 'any sparse mask over hourly return signs earns the same — it is generic short-horizon momentum, not the arrival clock'). Placebo book: identical mechanics, fills, holding (K=2), costs and force-flat law; but within each symbol-month block of 720 consecutive buckets, the anchor's trigger positions are randomly permuted across buckets of the same block with a seeded PRNG (numpy default_rng, fixed seed 17040002, one draw per block, frozen) — preserving the number of events per block while destroying the alignment between the arrival signature and the hours it fired on; direction for each placebo event is recomputed from the resampled bucket's own sign(last_price - first_price). G11 contract: if the placebo reproduces the anchor (same sign AND |placebo pooled after-cost expectancy| >= 0.5 x |anchor pooled after-cost expectancy|), the family DIES — the drift was generic masked momentum, not arrival structure.
exposure_series_spec: Conditioning exposure series for D2 novelty measurement, per symbol s, aligned to decision time t = close of trigger bucket b: e_t^s = dir(b) x 1[entry_gap_s(b) >= Q90_s(b) AND n_trades(b) >= 1.5 x M_s(b)] with dir(b) = sign(last_price(b) - first_price(b)), Q90_s(b) = 90th percentile of entry_gap_s over buckets b-720..b-1 (same symbol), M_s(b) = median of n_trades over buckets b-720..b-1 (same symbol); e_t^s = 0 in all non-trigger buckets. Pooled series e_t = vertical concatenation of e_t^BTCUSDT and e_t^ETHUSDT in symbol-then-time order. Every input is a published section-2 column or a trailing-window statistic thereof, so D2 can compute the exact series and its pooled |rho| against every forbidden conditioning exposure (tsmom, M01 absorption, run persistence/imbalance, dollar-volume shock, ILLIQ/LIQEPIS, vol-compression, displacement-fade families).
falsification_rule: Pre-registered and mechanical; the family DIES if ANY of: (1) G11: the reshuffled-interval placebo reproduces the anchor — same sign AND |placebo pooled after-cost expectancy| >= 0.5 x |anchor pooled after-cost expectancy| (tier 2.0, pooled over symbols and folds). (2) Anchor pooled after-cost expectancy <= 0 at tier 2.0 (G1). (3) G12: pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the exposure_series_spec series and ANY forbidden-inventory conditioning exposure, measured at D2. (4) Coverage fail-closed: anchor trigger duty outside [5%, 60%] of decision buckets per symbol (degenerate coverage — too starved to test or too dense to be an arrival-structure mechanism), or fewer than 30 scored trigger events in any single fold.
expected_failure_interpretation: A REJECT means the post-silence quote-recentering drift carries no after-cost edge at taker tier 2.0 in S0: either colocated liquidity providers re-center within less than one bucket in the 2025-26 regime, or the hour-scale drift per round trip is smaller than taker costs, or the placebo reproduces the anchor and the 'drift' was generic short-horizon momentum wearing an arrival mask (family dead by control, not by cost — the arrival-clock information source itself is then disconfirmed). No re-parameterization of the silence threshold, resumption multiple or holding window is licensed after a reject (that would be rescue by threshold re-label).
expected_failure_mode: Cost domination (named risk of the intraday frontier). Turnover estimate per decision: at an assumed 10-20% trigger duty the book turns over ~0.2-0.4 fills per decision-symbol (entry + time exit per event, flips counted as two fills), i.e., ~1,750-3,500 fills per year per symbol, ~3,500-7,000 pooled. At tier 2.0 each round trip costs ~2 x (10 bps + 2-tick slip floor) = ~20+ bps per symbol-event against a 2-bucket (2-hour) holding horizon, so the mechanism must clear ~20+ bps of drift per event before any edge exists; the primary kill mode is per-round-trip drift < per-round-trip taker cost at tier 2.0, with stress multipliers on booked PnL on top.
